user.title: Swiss Lottery
user.description: Shows the published results of a Swisslos game – the latest draw, the jackpot and the next draw – and checks your own tickets against them. Add the integration once per game.

data_description.tickets: Main numbers followed by the bonus number(s), for example «4 11 19 27 33 41 + 5» for Swiss Lotto (6 numbers + lucky number), «3 17 24 38 46 + 2 9» for EuroMillions (5 numbers + 2 stars) or «4 8 15 16 23 38 + 1» for EuroDreams (6 numbers + dream number). Commas work too; without a «+» the last number(s) count as the bonus. Tickets can be changed later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: swisslos.ch could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_page: The results page of swisslos.ch does not have the expected structure. The integration may need an update.
error.ticket_count: Ticket «{line}» has the wrong number of picks for this game.
error.ticket_duplicate: Ticket «{line}» contains the same number twice.
error.ticket_range: Ticket «{line}» contains a number outside the allowed range.

abort.already_configured: This game is already set up. Change its tickets under Configure.

init.title: Tickets – {game}
init.description: One ticket per line: the main numbers, then «+» and the bonus number(s). Leave empty to track the draws without tickets.

ticket_won.name: A ticket has won
ticket_won.description: Triggers when the latest draw pays out on at least one of your tickets. The winning tickets with rank and prize are attributes of the win sensor.

draw_published.name: A draw was published
draw_published.description: Triggers when Swisslos publishes a new draw of the game (the draw date changes).

jackpot_crossed_threshold.name: Jackpot crossed a threshold
jackpot_crossed_threshold.description: Triggers when the jackpot of the next draw crosses the configured amount in CHF.

ticket_has_won.name: A ticket has won
ticket_has_won.description: Tests if the latest draw pays out on at least one of your tickets.

no_ticket_has_won.name: No ticket has won
no_ticket_has_won.description: Tests if none of your tickets won the latest draw.

unreachable.title: Swiss Lottery: data service unreachable
unreachable.description: The service at {host} has not answered for several refreshes in a row. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the service itself is down. The entities stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

page_changed.title: Swiss Lottery: swisslos.ch page not understood
page_changed.description: The results page of swisslos.ch could not be read for several refreshes in a row ({error}). Swisslos has most likely changed the page; the integration needs an update to follow. The draw entities keep their last values until then. Check the Marketplace for a newer version of Swiss Lottery or report the problem on GitHub; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.
